data.answer: Tom & Chee's top competitors include Yours Truly Restaurants, Submarine House, and Blue Wolf Tavern, with an annual revenue of $22.9M and 131 employees. The restaurant specializes in grilled cheese sandwiches and tomato soup, offering elevated comfort food with options like gluten-free bread, vegan cheese, and vegan/vegetarian menu items. It has been featured on ABC's Shark Tank, The Chew, and The Travel Channel's Man vs. Food Nation and Amazing Eats.
